## getAuditLogPath() function

Resolve the absolute path of this Mac's governance audit log.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function getAuditLogPath(): string
```

**Returns:**

string

Absolute path to the audit log.

## Remarks

The log sits beside the policy and approval registration it records decisions for: `<macts-home>/governance/audit.jsonl`<!-- -->, one JSON record per line.
